name: std::generic_category
intro: Obtains a reference to the static error category object for generic errors. The object is required to override the virtual function error_category::name() to return a pointer to the string "generic". It is used to identify error conditions that correspond to the POSIX errno codes.

sections.title: Return value
sections.text: A reference to the static object of unspecified runtime type, derived from std::error_category.

examples.output:

Value: 33
